name: cmd_preset_import
description: Import Presets (command `preset.import`). Params: {paths: [file or folder], group?, dryRun?} — .lcpreset, XMP presets, .lrtemplate, photos carrying edits (DNG/JPEG/TIFF "DNG presets"), Luminar looks (.lmp, .mplumpack collections) and .zip bundles of these; folders give their name as group; crs: fields mapped per docs/xmp-interop.md → {imported: [{id,name,group,file,unmapped}], skipped, failed}.
